description.text:
Feel like you never left the spa with our new and super-ior Super-Plush Towels, made with luxurious upgrades like premium 100% Aegean Turkish Cotton; zero twist construction for softness and lasting quality; and quicker dry time and improved absorbency. Bath time doesn’t get better than this.
How It Feels
Super-soft and extra-thick without the weight
How It Looks
Stylish, luxurious, and super-fun
Details
What’s Included:
2 Bath Towels
Material:
100% Aegean Turkish Cotton, 770 GSM
100% Aegean Turkish cotton
offers premium strength and smoothness, significantly boosting the towel's absorbency and durability.
Zero-twist construction
opens the fibers to maximize absorbency and softness while increasing airflow for faster drying.
Signature locker loop
for hanging dry
Made In:
Turkey
Care
Machine wash cold. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. For best results, wash with our Essential Detergent and dry with Wool Dryer Balls.
Due to the zero-twist construction of this towel, you may you may notice shedding/linting during the first few washes. However, because we use 100% Aegean Turkish Cotton—a premium long-staple fiber—the yarns are stronger and more durable, resulting in a longer-lasting towel.
If you’re following a skincare or haircare routine that includes active ingredients, we recommend white towels to avoid discoloration.
description.html:
Feel like you never left the spa with our new and super-ior Super-Plush Towels, made with luxurious upgrades like premium 100% Aegean Turkish Cotton; zero twist construction for softness and lasting quality; and quicker dry time and improved absorbency. Bath time doesn’t get better than this.

How It Feels

Super-soft and extra-thick without the weight 

How It Looks

Stylish, luxurious, and super-fun

Details

  • What’s Included: 2 Bath Towels
  • Material: 100% Aegean Turkish Cotton, 770 GSM
  • 100% Aegean Turkish cotton offers premium strength and smoothness, significantly boosting the towel's absorbency and durability.
  • Zero-twist construction opens the fibers to maximize absorbency and softness while increasing airflow for faster drying.
  • Signature locker loop for hanging dry
  • Made In: Turkey

Care

Machine wash cold. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. For best results, wash with our Essential Detergent and dry with Wool Dryer Balls.

Due to the zero-twist construction of this towel, you may you may notice shedding/linting during the first few washes. However, because we use 100% Aegean Turkish Cotton—a premium long-staple fiber—the yarns are stronger and more durable, resulting in a longer-lasting towel.

If you’re following a skincare or haircare routine that includes active ingredients, we recommend white towels to avoid discoloration.

reviews.comments: Super plush Turkish bath towels. No kidding these are the plushest towels I have ever had the pleasure of using. Wrapping them around you makes you feel like you’re at a luxury resort. My next order is already in the works! Well worth the money.

Perfect Plush. First time ordering from Brooklinen and I'm hooked. I ordered both the Super plush and Plush. I fell in love with the standard plush set and will be stocking the rest of my house with them. Very soft and plush without being too thick.
Super soft, plush towel. It feels so nice to wrap myself in this towel. It’s a great size for a bath towel. Feels like a little piece of luxury every time I use it.

So plush, so worth it! Great, high-quality thick towels. Using them after a shower feels like a total luxury! And my family loves them too. They are worth the money. When guests come over they always praise the towels! Love the Storm color. Do yourself a favor and get these!

Our New Favorite Towels. These towels are the first we’ve ever had that check every box. Soft and a little fluffy. Dry us off without repeated rubbing. First pass, done. Still look new after laundered. Generously thick and sized, no skimping here. Dry faster after hung up - so if I shower more than once in the same day, it’s ready to go. Love them!

Great product. Very plush and love the thickness, great quality. Color looks great on my hand. The stripes are a great touch and after the first wash, things were typical in the washing machine. They do take some time to dry though hanging up on the towel rack after use.
Dries quickly, light weight but fluffy and luxurious! I got the green and white stripes and the color looks so good in my bathroom. Worth the splurge!
Quality and longevity. Bought one set and then another one for when I have guests over. It’s worth paying for the quality to have something that’ll last you for years.

Amazing. The Plush Turkish Towels are thick, soft, and genuinely feel hotel-quality. They’re very absorbent without feeling overly heavy, and the fabric stays comfortable against the skin rather than becoming rough after washing. The size is generous, the construction feels durable, and they make the bathroom feel noticeably more luxurious. They do take a little longer to dry than thinner towels, but that’s a fair tradeoff for how plush and substantial they are. Overall, they’re an excellent choice if softness and comfort are your priorities. And the stripes are gorgeous.

Love our new Brooklinen bath sheets. They are super soft and huge. Even my husband noticed the quality and size. That kind of says it all. I've washed the towels using Brooklinen essential detergent and they continue to look and perform like new. Love the patterns and colors which are distinctive. I was looking for towels that were non-toxic, luxurious and high quality. These hit the mark. Couldn't be happier.
